prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a rugged, stone-paved path that winds through a dense forest on Shengshan Island, Zhoushan, China. The camera smoothly glides over the uneven terrain, capturing the intricate details of moss-covered stones and scattered foliage underfoot. As the viewer progresses, the surrounding environment reveals tall trees with thick canopies, their leaves swaying gently in the breeze, casting dappled shadows on the path. The cloudy, foggy weather creates a muted palette of greens and grays, enhancing the serene yet mysterious atmosphere. The camera occasionally pans slightly to the left and right, offering glimpses of the dense underbrush and the occasional rocky outcrop. The path meanders through the forest, leading past an old, ivy-covered building partially obscured by vegetation, hinting at a forgotten history. The natural light filters through the clouds, creating soft highlights and subtle contrasts, while the absence of any other characters or sounds emphasizes the solitude and tranquility of the scene. The continuous forward motion maintains a steady pace, allowing the viewer to fully absorb the rich textures and details of this untouched natural landscape.
